Heat the wraps and start by spreading the avocado on each one, add the egg salad, the diced tomato, the chopped onion and parsley at the end. Add salt and pepper.

ru.name: Spanish tortilla
ru.steps:
Pre-heat the oven to 180-200C
Peel and slice the potatoes place on a baking tray lined with parchment paper and bake for about 15 minutes until cooked. In a non-stick frying pan put the olive oil and the sliced onion and let it saute until golden.
In a bowl add the eggs and egg whites and beat, add salt and pepper, the potatoes and the onion, mix well.
Pour the tortilla batter into a frying pan and cook for about 6-8 minutes on the first side. Grab a large plate, put the plate on top of the pan and flip, slide the tortilla back into the pan and let the other side cook for 6-8 minutes. Then flip back out onto a clean plate.

In a frying pan saute the sliced mushrooms, the chopped tomatoes, with salt and pepper and balsamic vinegar.

Use the back of a spoon and, press into the centre of the sourdough to indent. Spoon in the custard mixture into the indented well and add your cherries on top.
Put in the oven for about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, on the last slice of bread, add the cream cheese and strawberry jam.

Spread the avocado over two slices of sourdough, slice the mozzarella and tomato and place alternately on top of it.
Put it in the oven for 5-10 minutes so that the mozzarella melts.
While beating the eggs and egg whites and in a non-stick frying pan make an omelette and fold it into an envelope.
Remove the sourdough from the oven, season with salt, pepper, balsamic vinegar and Italian seasoning, add the omelette and the basil.
